RagShortTexts: Bordeaux anchored English Gascony, funneling lucrative claret wine fleets across the Bay of.

Variants.Content: Bordeaux anchored English Plantagenet dominion in continental Gascony. Dominating the Garonne, huge autumn fleets transported claret wine to England under royal convoys, securing baronial privileges and prosperous municipal liberty.
English customs revenues depended directly upon Bordeaux vintage yields, binding civic burghers inextricably to the crown of England.
